# Creating date and time -------------------------------------------------

## Order Matters
The order of the letters in the function name describe the order of the components in the date string. Under the hood, *dates* are doubles. Days since 1970-01-01.

```{r}
ymd("2017-01-31")
mdy("January 31st, 2017")
dmy("31-Jan-2017")

# type and class of a date
my_date <- dmy("31-Jan-2017")
typeof(my_date)
class(my_date)
unclass(dmy("31-Jan-1900"))

# Datetimes
ymd_hms("2017-01-31 20:11:59")
mdy_hm("1/31/2017 08:01")
```
